title: Scale review depth by change risk
body:
A tasks-only PR (#117) ran the full three-judge panel and gate. Classify a change by its paths (tasks/docs only, tests only, product code, CI/installer/release) and choose panel size and depth per class, with CI/installer/release always full depth.
Acceptance: the class is computed from the diff, recorded in the review record, and a tasks-only change runs the light path while installer/CI changes always run the full panel.
